game_concept: A racing platformer set in Mt. Pyre – Magma Forge, a forge fed by magma: the ash ranger must handle fire sprites while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – String Glue: Concatenate string pieces to forge passwords and spell names.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Magma Forge: a forge fed by magma
core_gameplay_loop: In Magma Forge, repeat each round: Concatenate string pieces to forge passwords and spell names. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the ash ranger ahead. Then check the spell_ok value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the summit beacon by solving code steps involving spell_ok that move the ash ranger forward.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.8).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the summit beacon first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 1 (intro tier): String Glue
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'String Glue' (Week 2 slot 7), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Magma Forge'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how spell_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against fire sprites in Magma Forge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.8).
